dedupe_keys.name: okir hungary national environmental information system with modules for waste management ehir air lair surface water fevisz groundwater favi e prtr and nature and the what is in my environment data browser

description: OKIR is Hungary's National Environmental Information System, the central database where environmental, nature protection, waste and water authorities record data on pollution loads and the state of the environment. The home page read on 2026-09-28 explains that the data come partly from the authorities' own measurements and partly from reports that facility operators must submit by law, entered directly into a central system operated by the Ministry of Energy. Modules cover waste management (EHIR), air quality protection (LAIR), surface water protection (FEVISZ), groundwater and geological media (FAVI), the European pollutant release and transfer register (E-PRTR) and nature protection (TIR), and a public data browser, "What is in my environment?", lets anyone look up the registered sites and emitters around a location. Coverage is Hungary. Access to the public browser is free; no licence is stated, and export options were not checked. Caveats: the site is in Hungarian, and much of OKIR serves operators' mandatory reporting, so public views may be limited. It supports exposure and capacity studies, such as locating waste treatment facilities and industrial emitters near water intakes or flood zones. No related Hungarian environmental record is catalogued.
